Question: Walter gets up at \(6:30\) a.m., catches the school bus at \(7:30\) a.m., has \(6\) classes that last \(50\) minutes each, has \(30\) minutes for lunch, and has \(2\) hours additional time at school. He takes the bus home and arrives at \(4:00\) p.m. How many minutes has he spent on the bus?
Solution:
Start at \(7{:}30\) a.m., when Walter boards the first bus. From then until \(4{:}00\) p.m. is \(8\) hours \(30\) minutes, or
\[
8\cdot60+30=510\text{ minutes}.
\]
This interval consists of the two bus rides and his time at school.

His six classes take \(6\cdot50=300\) minutes, and the additional two hours take \(120\) minutes. Including lunch, his school time is
\[
300+30+120=450\text{ minutes}.
\]
Therefore, his total time on the bus is
\[
510-450=60\text{ minutes}.
\]
The answer is \(60\) minutes, choice B.
